aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (dark) fused with an audio-plugin instrument panel — near-black canvas, electric multi-hue accents, glowing primary, tracked-mono eyebrows, geometric-grotesque display; a 'dark synth workstation' web look

psychology: Von Restorff / isolation — per-voice identity colors make each layer instantly trackable in a dense multi-object oscilloscope; correct use of option density in an expert workspace (not a decision point, so not thinned)
Jakob's Law — violated on chrome (fakes a Mac window it doesn't honor) but honored in the audio schema (knobs/ADSR/LFO match the DAW mental model sound designers already carry)
Aesthetic-Usability effect — polished neon-dark hero is a strong first-viewport thesis (what it is + one action), buying first-contact trust
Hick's Law — dense knob field left rich (expert browse), while true decision points (sample rate, bit depth) are reduced to 2-3-option segmented choosers
Fitts's Law — big Play/Save bottom-right (schema-correct primary placement) but tiny per-card header targets undercut it
notes: Marketing composites of a web app (mjsfx.app), not native macOS screenshots — digested as CONTRAST evidence (lineage web-electron, high confidence); excluded from macOS canon and native clusters. Shots 1 & 6 are the same workspace surface (hero vs full); shots 2-5 are frameless component showcases, not standalone app surfaces; cover is pure brand. All measurements from @2x (2880x1800 -> logical 1440x900) marketing PNGs — pixel-sampled colors are (measured), geometry is (estimated) with ranges.
